Lena (Product): follow-up from the all-hands Q&A  teams want a concise, public-friendly timeline for: Console batching controls, API billing tiers, and Optimize suggestions. can we commit to a short sentence + owners today?

Miles (Eng): engineering shorthand: Console batching internal canary 2024-06-26; partner beta early July; public rollout late July (pending ops cert). API tiers beta end of July, GA mid-August. Optimize read-only suggestions 2024-06-30; write-mode later.

Ana (DevEx): will draft migration checklist and AE script. need opt-out examples and rollback steps.

Priya (Legal): legal: send proposed tier terms by July 1 and we'll return redlines by July 10. confirm whether tiering is opt-in for existing keys (recommended).

Jon (Sales): sales asks: one-page migration playbook, sample customer message, and a rollback blurb for AEs. please include Dedicated notice windows.

Miles (Eng): opt-out admin API (example): PUT /admin/v1/tenant/features {"smart_batching": false} (admin only). telemetry will include batching_ratio and p50/p95 token latency.

Lena (Product): owner list: timeline doc + public sentence (owner: Lena) by EOD, migration playbook + AE script (owner: Ana) draft by July 3, legal terms to Priya by July 1, engineering canary PRs (owner: Miles) by June 21.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: runtime v1.9.3 -> us-west cluster on 2024-06-26T03:00:00Z (4 nodes).

Lena (Product): thanks all  i'll post the one-liner in #all-hands and #customer-comm and pin it. reconvene in #product-next-week if anything slips.
